This is the ninth chapter of the [[Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!]] manga. It was first published in the August 2022 issue of ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'', released on June 21, 2022.<ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20230817234606/https://www.bookshop-ps.com/bsp/bsp_magcode?sha=1&sho=1385908122 ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' August 2022 issue | Shogakukan BOOK SHOP] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20220621054057/https://corocoro.jp/news/337503/ ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' August 2022 issue | CoroCoro Comics] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kemonmon/status/1539907726897082369 Kemon Kawamoto on X (Twitter)] (Japanese)</ref> It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on November 27, 2023.
